title: feat: add download-only mode to installer dialog (fetch without installing)
observation: feat: add download-only mode to installer dialog (fetch without installing) ## Summary Add an option to download GOG (and other) installer files to the local cache without proceeding to installation. The user would trigger the normal install flow but choose to stop after the download completes, leaving the files on disk for later offline use. ## Motivation Currently the only way to cache installer files locally is to run through the full install dialog and cancel or fail mid-install — which is fragile and risks triggering the post-failure cleanup that was the subject of #6449. Users with large GOG libraries on metered or unreliable connections need to be able to: - Pre-download installers while connectivity is available - Install later, fully offline - Archive installer files against future GOG CDN unavailability There is no supported way to do this today without going through each game'
